title: The Empty Verdict
author: Theo Dravenmoor
blurb: Bram Hartwell, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the trial begins.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
